skills.name: autoresearch-optimizer
skills.description: Autonomous experiment loop that turns Hubsy into a self-improving researcher. Form a hypothesis, modify a target asset or prompt, run a fixed evaluation metric, and keep the change only if the score improves or revert if it is worse. Modeled on karpathy/autoresearch (edits train.py against a fixed val_bpb evaluator while a program.md direction file steers the loop), generalized to prompts, configs, and code. Use for overnight/autonomous optimization, iterative experimentation, prompt tuning, and benchmark-driven change review.

skills.name: google-workspace-cli
skills.description: Drive Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets, Docs, Chat, and other Google Workspace APIs from the terminal using the gws CLI (googleworkspace/cli). Every gws command returns structured JSON and the command surface is built dynamically from Google's Discovery Service. Use whenever the user wants to check or send email, manage calendar events and agendas, list or upload Drive files, read or write spreadsheet cells and rows, edit documents, or send Google Chat messages.
